caption:
Today's Sky is Yang Earth, The Mountain ⛰️ Pause on your Day Master.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today the mountain meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Earth gets a friend day, Yin Metal feels supported, Yang Water feels the weight.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

How's your Saturday looking? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #zodiacsigns #metaphysics #personalgrowth #fourpillars #chineseastrology #fengshuitips #singapore
day_line: A mountain on a Tiger day. Solid but restless: good for big chores and long walks, easy to dig in your heels.

lines.Yang Wood: A weekend find is waiting today: a sale, a tip, a good spot. Grab it, keep the receipt.
lines.Yin Wood: Sort the week's spending today. The cart can stay a cart until Monday.
lines.Yang Fire: Play mode today. Plan the outing, pick the music, let someone else drive.
lines.Yin Fire: You'll say what you really think today. Kind words land better than sharp ones.
lines.Yang Earth: Old friends ping today. Meet for supper; don't turn it into a debate.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone's in the same long queue today. Smile and wait; the char kway teow is worth it.
lines.Yang Metal: A slow morning gives you a clear head today. Write down the idea before brunch.
lines.Yin Metal: Family looks after you today. Let them; you can do the dishes after.
lines.Yang Water: Errands pile up today. Do the two that matter and park the rest.
lines.Yin Water: Someone thanks you properly today. Take the compliment without explaining it away.
